method: Primary listing descriptions and coordinate tables were acquired through the web retrieval tool. Raw HTML requests returned 403 and were not bypassed. Exact retrieved representations are retained with SHA-256; they are not described as original HTML. Numeric CE century bounds are 100*(firstCentury-1)+1 through 100*lastCentury.

snapshots.representation: Web tool extracted page text and retrieval metadata; not original HTML bytes.

interpretation.zh: 来源以6—10世纪概括古城与关联古迹所体现的陀罗钵地文化时期；年份按整世纪转换，用于筛选这一阶段。建城、弃城及逐年居住情况另需考证。
interpretation.en: UNESCO dates the Dvaravati cultural phase represented by the town and associated monuments to the sixth through tenth centuries. The numeric bounds convert those centuries for filtering; foundation, abandonment and annual occupation require separate evidence.

coordinateMeaning.zh: UNESCO 1662-001 古城组成部分的代表点。
coordinateMeaning.en: UNESCO reference point for the ancient-town component 1662-001.

entries.dateQuote: repairs and modifications carried out from the 7th to the 11th century

interpretation.zh: 筛选范围对应来源记载的7—11世纪寺庙修缮与改建活动。伊奢那补罗作为真腊都城的早期背景另述于正文；两种年代含义分别保留。
interpretation.en: The filter range represents the seventh–eleventh-century repairs and modifications documented for the temples. The earlier Chenla-capital context of Ishanapura is described separately in the narrative.

coordinateMeaning.zh: UNESCO 寺区遗产代表点；带护城河的古城遗迹位于寺区以西。
coordinateMeaning.en: UNESCO reference point for the temple-zone property; the moated city remains lie to its west.
